status: Matched explicit-budget E2E improvement accepted under the updated user criterion; metadata regression is an accepted tradeoff; default-budget behavior was not measured

definitions.cold: First traversal/read after explicit stats bootstrap on a fresh client mount/cache directory; some permission metadata is warm, and server/host caches are not dropped. Do not compare this phase's absolute times to the 6912 campaign without this prelude.
definitions.mount_preparation: mount_ms retains time until mount readiness; stats_initialization_ms covers bootstrap plus stable baseline; their sum is mount_preparation_ms. Native sampling is an overlapping subtotal and must not be added twice.
definitions.end_to_end_transfer_per_logical_read: E2E S3 response body bytes / (2 * files * 4096)
definitions.cache_hit_fraction: Whole-object boundary hits / (hits + misses), over the entire mount.
definitions.paired_reduction_percent: 100 * (1 - on / off), pairing adjacent off/on arms in either order.
definitions.end_to_end: Mount + two readdir/read passes + approximately 500ms idle observation + native counter sampling/boundary waits + unmount/drain.
